title: reconcile detection output (`effect reconcile` stdout)
description: The escape-detection object `effect reconcile` prints — the computeEscapes result (observed-minus-declared) in bin/lib/effects.js. IMPORTANT: unlike the other kinds, the shipped `effect reconcile` verb emits this to STDOUT and does NOT append a ledger record — no code path writes a `kind_of_entry: reconcile` line, though KIND_AUTHOR reserves that kind for the producer. A normal run produces no escape (`any_escape: false`, empty `escapes`); this example was generated under a forced escape. Shape normative here; semantics in ../records.md.

any_escape.description: true iff at least one observed effect is uncovered by a declaration

event_seq.description: the events.jsonl seq of the escape when known; null from the ledger-only reconcile path (any type)
